input.title: File:Dülmen, St.-Viktor-Kirche -- 2014 -- 0056.jpg
input.description: Tower with year sign of the Saint Viktor of  Xanten  Church,  Dülmen ,  North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The Roman Catholic parish church of St. Victor is the oldest church in Dülmen. It is located in the town center and is the only one within the former town walls. It was founded in 780 by Abbot Bernrad or St. Liudger on a Saxon (later episcopal) main farmstead. It is not only considered the original parish church of Dülmen, but also one of the oldest churches in the diocese of  Münster . The church is named after and dedicated to St. Victor. The consecration of a larger church, which was probably the first stone church, took place in 1074. The church building was destroyed, rebuilt, renovated, or remodeled several times, but was always oriented toward the east, the place of sunrise. The church took on its current form around 1500, but was destroyed on March 21 and 22, 1945, and then rebuilt, with traces of the difficult reconstruction still visible.

input.title: File:Kakegawa Castle, Kakegawa City.jpg
input.description: Kakegawa Castle   (掛川城,  Kakegawa-jō )  is a  hirayama-style  Japanese castle in  Kakegawa City [1] ,  Shizuoka Prefecture . The original Kakegawa Castle donjon or keep, first built by Yasuhiro Asahina in 1513, was partially destroyed in an earthquake in 1854 and was completely demolished in 1869 with the end of the Tokugawa regime.  140 years later in April 1994, sections of the innermost bailey  ( honmaru ) , including some walls,  (a  yagura ) , and the keep  ( tenshukaku ) , were reconstructed with great care using the original methods. It is famous as the first castle in Japan to be recreated using original wood construction techniques. [2] [3] [4]

input.title: File:Münster, St.-Paulus-Dom -- 2014 -- 00972.jpg
input.description: St Paul’s Cathedral ,  Münster ,  North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany St. Paul’s Cathedral is the cathedral of the Diocese of Münster and is dedicated to St. Paul the Apostle. This building is one of the landmarks of the city of Münster. Today’s St. Paul’s Cathedral is the third cathedral of the Diocese of Münster, following two previous buildings. The current building was constructed between 1225 and 1264 on the Horsteberg hill and has been repeatedly expanded and rebuilt. After suffering severe damage, the cathedral was rebuilt between 1946 and 1956 and solemnly consecrated in 1956. The cathedral and cathedral square with the adjacent buildings are located on the site of the Carolingian cathedral hill and cathedral immunity.

input.description: 掛川城は、静岡県掛川市にある平山風の日本の城です。 1513年に朝比奈康弘によって最初に建てられた元の掛川城天守衛は1854年の地震で部分的に破壊され、徳川政権の終焉とともに1869年に完全に破壊されました。 140年後1994年4月、壁、櫓、砦（天守）を含む最も内側のベイリー（本丸）のセクションが、独自の方法を使用して細心の注意を払って再構築されました。 独自の木造技術で再現された日本初の城として有名です。
